title: Test Gap: Add a test to verify XON/XOFF sent by peer doesn't increase drop counter
author: bingwang-ms
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the test gap

A test is needed to verify XON/XOFF sent by peer won't cause RX_DROP increase.

**Test steps**
1. Send XON or XOFF from peer device (leaf-fanout or any traffic generator)
2. Verify RX_DROP counter on DUT.

**Expectation**
RX_DROP should not increase if XON/XOFF is received.

### Affected Area

Counter and alert.

### Impact of missing tests and proposed tests

We can't verify if XON or XOFF is counted as RX_DROP

comments.author: bingwang-ms
comments.body: Reopen this issue as PR #20543 is not good enough to fill the test gap

linkedPullRequests.title: Test to verify RX_DROP does not increase on XON/XOFF pause frames
linkedPullRequests.author: Abdul-Wahab-17
linkedPullRequests.body:
### Description of PR
This PR adds a new test under tests/counter/ to verify that receiving IEEE 802.3x pause frames (XON/XOFF) does not incorrectly increment RX_DROP counters on the DUT

Summary:
Fixes #20499 

### Type of change



- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] New Test case
    - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [ ] Test case improvement


### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
The motivation is to address [Issue #20499](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/20499?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

#### How did you do it?
I implemented a new test test_xon_xoff_does_not_increase_rx_drop under tests/counter/.
The test selects a random operational DUT port.
It maps the DUT port to a PTF port index using tbinfo['topo']['ptf_map'].
It crafts valid IEEE 802.3x PAUSE frames (both XOFF with pause_time > 0 and XON with pause_time == 0).
Frames are transmitted from the PTF host towards the DUT.
RX_DROP counters are read before and after transmission using sonic-db-cli or redis-cli.
The test asserts that RX_DROP does not increase.


#### Any platform specific information?
No platform-specific dependencies.

#### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case?
The test supports topologies t0 and t1

comments.body:
Hi @Abdul-Wahab-17, there is some issue in the test
1. Test will be skipped because of code below. It's because of `dut_port` is something like `dut_name|port_name`, which will never appear in `ptf_map`  
```
    if dut_port not in ptf_map:
        pytest.skip(
            f"no ptf mapping for DUT port {dut_port} in tbinfo; can't run traffic"
        )
```
2. You can't send packet from ptf to DUT as the PFC_ON/OFF will not be forwarded by leaf fanout

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
This PR is to add a new test to verify `XON` and `XOFF` frame will not be counted in `RX_DROP`.

#### How did you do it?
Test steps
1. Capture `RX_DROP` for a certain port as base line
2. Send 1000 `XON` frames from leaf-fanout to DUT
3. Verify `RX_DROP` counter doesn't increase
4. Send 1000 `XOFF` frames from leaf-fanout to DUT
5. Verify `RX_DROP` counter doesn't increase

#### How did you verify/test it?
Verified on a physical testbed.
```

```
